daemon_reaching_requests: Each workload reports application-level syscall time AND the requests that actually reached the daemon, from the shared daemon-operation counters (uniform across F0/F1/F2) and, for F2, the native ring's requests_served counter.
method: REPEATED PAIRED runs: each repetition runs the identical workload under F0, F1 and F2 back to back. direct_io=on and attr/entry TTL=0 so every read and lookup is a real transport round-trip. Per-op samples are recorded; the mean carries a two-sided 95% Student-t interval and significance is judged on the paired difference of per-pair means. Numbers are observations, not models.

f2_capabilities.boundary: FUSE ABI 7.45 exposes only the baseline REGISTER + COMMIT_AND_FETCH interface; ADD_QUEUE/ADD_BUFPOOL and zero-copy are inert (not offered)

capabilities.boundary: FUSE ABI 7.45 exposes only the baseline REGISTER + COMMIT_AND_FETCH interface; ADD_QUEUE/ADD_BUFPOOL and zero-copy are inert (not offered)

servicing_benchmark.decision_rule: pool default only if 16-reader throughput gain is a significant positive paired margin AND read_4k latency has no significant regression

statistics.significance: paired-t interval of (F2-F0) and (F2-F1) pair means excluding 0

read_1b.workload: 400 pread of 1 B at deterministic offsets (direct_io)

read_4k.workload: 400 pread of 4096 B at deterministic offsets

read_64b.workload: 400 pread of 64 B at deterministic offsets

read_64k.workload: 200 pread of 64 KiB at deterministic offsets
